messages:
maria: :wave: Quick heads-up — legal signoff landed. We're scheduling the v1 API sunset notice for next Wednesday (customer-facing). Need a short migration snippet, updated SDK examples, and a docs banner. Who can pick up which pieces?

liam: I can own SDK snippets. Will update TS/py/Go minimal examples and push a compat note. ETA tomorrow EOD.

emma: I'll handle the redirect links and the banner copy. Can someone confirm the canonical migration page URL to link to?

jordan: I'll run the example snippets against the staging endpoint once liam's PR is in. Also can add a short checklist for customers migrating models (hint: model swap + tokenization check).

maria: Link should be /docs/guides/v1-to-v2-migration (we're creating that page under guides). Make sure the banner points to that path.

liam: draft snippet for python (will paste here):
```python
# v2 migration note: replace client.models.generate -> client.chat.completions.create
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.chat.completions.create(model="redwood-v2", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

ravi: quick note on model swaps — we should warn about potential tokenization diffs when swapping to newer model families. I'll add a short blurb under the migration page.

emma: banner copy draft: "We're retiring the v1 API on <date>. Update to v2 for continued access — read the migration guide." Ping me for tone changes.

maria: Docs-bot, can you create a checklist PR template for the migration guide?

docs-bot: Created PR checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4321 — includes sections: snippets updated, redirects added, SDK tests, legal copy check.

liam: FYI I found one inline example that uses `model: 'gpt-3.1'` which doesn't map to v2. I'll include mapping notes and a small script to rewrite model names in samples.

jordan: testing plan: smoke test TS/py snippets, verify streaming examples, run example outputs through our eval harness to ensure no regression. I can start after liam's PR.

maria: Great. Owners: liam (SDK snippets), emma (links/banner), rami? ravi (migration blurbs), jordan (validation). Please tag the PRs with `v1-sunset` label. I'll run the announcement draft by comms once the guide is live.

liam: tagging plan: I'll open SDK PR + sample-app PR. Will include a compat shim example for very small code diffs.

emma: When you push the redirects, please add a note in the redirect map: old /api/v1/* -> /docs/guides/v1-to-v2-migration mapping.

ravi: Suggestion: add a tiny code snippet showing `model_map = {"old-model":"redwood-v2-small"}` and how to programmatically swap. I'll add to the migration page.

maria: Timeline recap: snippets in by EOD tomorrow, redirects + banner before Monday, validation and announcement copy Monday afternoon. If any blockers, flag here. :rocket:
